title: Labor-based share of tax revenue, United States
license: Source: OECD, Revenue Statistics 2025. OECD terms and conditions: https://www.oecd.org/en/about/terms-conditions.html
notes: Formula: (revenue category 1100 taxes on income of individuals + 2000 social security contributions) as a percentage of total tax revenue, general government, from dataflow OECD.CTP.TPS,DSD_REV_COMP_OECD@DF_RSOECD,2.0. The OECD average is the published OECD_REP aggregate (each category's percentage of total tax revenue is as published, not recomputed).
